entities.summary: Dexter Alexander Davis is an American former professional football player who was a defensive end in the National Football League (NFL) and Canadian Football League (CFL). He was selected by the Seattle Seahawks in the seventh round of the 2010 NFL draft. He played college football for the Arizona State Sun Devils.
